messages:
Alyssa (Docs): Quick sync - I'm proposing we standardize on the term 'instruction' instead of 'prompt' in all public docs and SDK snippets. Opening a guidelines PR and a small migration note. Thoughts?
Sam K. (SDK): Do we mean rename parameter names or just doc wording? Renaming params is a breaking change.
Alyssa (Docs): Wording only for now. We'll keep SDK params as-is but add a clear mapping table and a migration guide that explains the rationale and suggests code examples.
Priya (Docs): +1 for wording change. We should update the glossary entry and add a short section in the style guide about when to use 'instruction' vs 'prompt template' vs 'prompt' (legacy).
Marco (I18n): Heads up - if we change public wording, translation teams will need a key list. Please add a single JSON export of all user-facing strings in the PR so we can queue the strings for localization.
Alyssa (Docs): Good call. I'll include an i18n-strings.json in the PR diff. Also plan to add a 'language' note for Japanese/KO where the literal translation of 'prompt' is overloaded.
Sam K. (SDK): For snippets, let's provide both terms inline for 1 release: comment that says "aka prompt" so users searching old docs still find examples. Eg: ```python
# preferred: use 'instruction' wording in docs
resp = client.generate(instruction="Summarize this text")
# legacy: some SDKs still accept prompt param
resp = client.generate(prompt="Summarize this text")
```
Priya (Docs): I can craft a short blurb for the changelog about the terminology change and the search/replace we ran across docs. Will also add redirects for common URLs that use 'prompt' in the slug.
Alyssa (Docs): I'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288 - checklist: style guide update, glossary rewrite, snippets dual-labeling, i18n keys export, redirects, changelog entry.
preview-bot: Preview deploy for PR 1288 available at https://deploy-preview-1288--docs.redwood.ai — checks passed
Marco (I18n): Reviewing the JSON export format. One ask: include context comments (short) per string to help translators understand when to prefer formal vs conversational tone.
Sam K. (SDK): Also adding a tiny test that asserts examples in docs compilation still build (so codeblocks don't break CI).
Priya (Docs): I'll add a small quickstart note under "Migration tips" with copy-paste examples for the web quickstart and the CLI.
Alyssa (Docs): Thanks all. After 2 approvals I'll merge and ping #docs and #devex so SDK folks know how we phrased things. We'll revisit in 2 weeks if any customer confusion spikes.
